_comment: Default hook configuration. Copy to <project-root>/.claude/hook-config.json and edit. Hook scripts in this repo read this file (or fall back to these defaults) to determine project-specific policy. Project-agnostic by design: the same hook script works for any repo; the config makes it specific.

block_loose_files._doc: PreToolUse Write hook: block scratch/debug/adhoc files at repo root. patterns are prefix or glob fragments; allowed_dirs lists directories where the patterns are permitted.

block_hardcoded_paths._doc: PreToolUse Write|Edit hook: block hardcoded absolute paths in module code. forbidden_prefixes are path prefixes that may not appear in quotes inside enforce_in files. allowlist_files are excepted (typical: a paths registry module).

warn_untracked_artifacts._doc: Stop hook: warn when artifact files are untracked in git. patterns are file extensions; excluded_dirs lists subdirs to ignore (typical: cache dirs).
